Youth@Work Digital Competences Forum 2026 (3rd Edition)

Conference – Symposium - Forum
1-5 December 2026 | Antalya, Türkiye

This Forum moves from discussion to practice. It offers a space for professionals to explore digital pedagogy and address the ethical and practical dimensions of AI in non-formal education and youth employment.
